artifact: PHASE 4D §42 - what the later solver receives, and how this phase stays neutral
phase4eReceives: the immutable CapacityState and its hash
the CapacityGraph and its dependency manifest
a pure simulateTransaction that evaluates one explicitly specified transaction against one explicitly selected path
deterministic transaction, simulation and post-state identities
phase4eWillDo: solve for a maximum transaction size
phase4dRemainsNeutral: the caller supplies the path; no alternative is considered
